Middle Tennessee ranks 93rd on defense, holding its opponents to 40.7%. Sam Houston ranks 75th in the FBS with a -1 turnover margin, compared to Middle Tennessee's 17th-ranked +6 margin. Sam Houston ranks 135th in the FBS averaging 79.7 penalty yards per game, compared to Middle Tennessee's 64th-ranked 54 per-game average. Sam Houston ranks 131st in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 71.4% of trips. Team leaders Middle Tennessee Passing: Roman Gagliano, 2,101 yards, 18 TDs, 4 INTs, 60.4 completion percentage Rushing: Antonio Martin, 750 yards on 140 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Cam'ron Lacy, 676 yards on 64 catches, 4 TDs Sam Houston Passing: Landyn Locke, 1,850 yards, 14 TDs, 5 INTs, 63.2 completion percentage Rushing: Alton McCaskill, 288 yards on 72 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Reed, 485 yards on 33 catches, 5 TDs Last game Middle Tennessee lost 28-23 to Liberty on Nov. 14. Gagliano led Middle Tennessee with 202 yards on 24-of-34 passing (70.6%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball eight times for 47 yards. Martin had 39 rushing yards on 12 carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for three yards. Lacy put up 97 yards on 10 catches. Sam Houston was beaten by Kennesaw State 26-7 on Nov. 14. Locke passed for 71 yards on 9-of-15 attempts (60.0%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. McCaskill carried the ball 10 times for 53 yards. Reed put up 48 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Next game Middle Tennessee hosts New Mexico State on Nov. 28. Sam Houston plays at Florida International on Nov. 28.
